title: Efficacy and Safety of DF289 Plus DF277 Otic Solution in the Treatment of Middle Ear Infections in Pediatric Patients
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine if a combination of an antibiotic plus a corticosteroid is safe and effective in treating middle ear infections in children with ear tubes.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 6 months to 12 years
* ear tube in the ear which will be treated
* otorrhea for 3 weeks or less
* moderate or severe otorrhea

Exclusion Criteria:

* other ear diseases
